title: Plant Manager
text:
Overview:

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What you will do::

As the Plant Manager, you will serve as the senior leader of the operation, with full responsibility for the facility's operational performance, customer experience, employee engagement, and financial results. You will lead a truss manufacturing business serving residential, commercial, multifamily, and agricultural construction markets while driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and a culture centered on safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will:

* Assume full P&L responsibility for the business, including revenue growth, gross margin performance, operating expenses, EBITDA, and overall profitability.
* Develop and execute business plans that drive market share growth, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Lead all day-to-day operations of the truss manufacturing facility, including production, engineering/design, purchasing, scheduling, inventory, logistics, maintenance, and quality.
* Partner with sales leadership to drive revenue growth, strengthen customer relationships, expand market opportunities, and improve competitive positioning.
* Analyze financial and operational performance metrics, identify trends, and implement action plans that improve profitability and business results.
* Maintain accountability for budgeting, forecasting, cost management, capital expenditures, working capital, and inventory performance.
* Lead and develop supervisors, managers, and frontline team members while creating a high-performance culture focused on accountability and results.
* Champion safety, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives across all aspects of the operation.
* Ensure production capacity, staffing, and operational resources are aligned with customer demand and growth objectives.
* Foster strong relationships with contractors, builders, developers, architects, engineers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead change management initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that enhance operational performance and long-term scalability.
* Serve as the primary business leader for the operation, balancing customer needs, employee development, operational execution, and financial performance.

What you will bring::

* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in truss manufacturing, engineered wood products, building materials, lumber, component manufacturing, construction products, or a related industry.
* Proven success leading a manufacturing operation with direct P&L ownership and accountability for revenue, margin, and profitability.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, cost controls, pricing strategies, capital investments, and financial performance.
* Experience driving profitable growth through operational improvements, sales partnership, customer development, and market expansion.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams including operations, production, purchasing, engineering/design, logistics, and customer-facing functions.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing KPIs, labor productivity, inventory management, throughput optimization, and supply chain operations.
* Experience building high-performing teams and developing future leaders.
* Proven ability to make data-driven business decisions and execute strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and leadership skills.

**Success in This Role**

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a business leader with the execution skills of an operations leader. This individual will take ownership of the entire operation, drive sustainable revenue and profitability growth, strengthen customer relationships, improve operational performance, and build an engaged, high-performing team. Success will be measured by the operation's safety performance, customer satisfaction, employee engagement, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and overall financial results.

What you will earn::

* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
* Paid training and certifications
* Legal assistance and identity protection
* Pet insurance
* Employee assistance program (EAP)
